submitted.rationale: Photocurrent rises with Ca content: Ca0.22 gave -1e-8 A, Ca0.50 gave 1.7e-7 A, and Ca0.77 gave 3.0e-7 A. XRD shows a secondary phase (peaks at Q≈3.20, 4.54 and 5.32) for Ca≥0.37, and it persists up to Ca0.78. Index 14, near the Ca-rich end, was the best measured.
